// non-blank name is given so that a blank name is rejected right away rather
// than failing after every other question has been answered.
func promptRepoName(ios *iostreams.IOStreams, prompter iprompter, defaultName string) (string, error) {
	cs := ios.ColorScheme()
	for {
		name, err := prompter.Input("Repository name", defaultName)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name != "" {
			return name, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(ios.ErrOut, "%s Repository name cannot be blank\n", cs.FailureIcon())
	}
}
